title: Supported generation of the Noetherian weak Serre heart
statement: Fix a prime ℓ and a condensed commutative ring Λ in the five coefficient families [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Let X be quasi-compact and locally Noetherian. For every ordinary internal Λ_X-module M in the weak Serre coproduct closure of finite scalar-model constructibles, M[0] belongs to supportedImageGenerationHull Λ X [lem-sfb-supported-image-bounded-derived-generation]. The locally Noetherian assumption is explicit and is not claimed to follow from qcqs.

Apply the defining minimality of the weak Serre coproduct closure to place M in it.

theorem noetherian_weakSerre_mem_supported_derived_generation
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : ObjectProperty.weakSerreCoproductClosure.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) M) :
    supportedImageGenerationHull Λ X ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)
